title: Mimicking an old man in Indiana, and regretting it
summary: Autrey mimicked a request in a speech impediment, making Fats fall off the stool, and still regrets hurting the old man.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And we played it. And one night I think we were in -- Indiana, or someplace, some simple old man came out, and I hated myself for this, some man came up, and we don't say nothing -- well, we always had some laughs going, some jokes going, and this guy came up and walked up to Fats and said (mimics speech impediment) (unintelligible). Fats said what did you want? And (mimics speech impediment) (unintelligible).

Fats say I don't know. Says -- he say Hermie, I say what? Do we have that? I said I never heard of it in my life. And Fats fell off the stool laughing. I'm sorry I did it. I shouldn't have. I never could -- I mimicked the man. That's the way he talked. I shouldn't have done that. But the poor man walked away. He went away. But I mean, but you don't stop to think, you know. You know. These are things you regret after.
Yeah, yeah, (mimics) and I never heard his head in my life. And Fats started laughing, and grabbed my hand, and he started, and he fell over.
Well, that happened. I couldn't call him back. I mean you don't take those things back, you know.
